description: Phase 4 MerLin adaptation of the reduced Table 1 ZINC run: GRIT with RRWP plus a two-photon walk encoding (21 + 20 channels), four seeds. The 20 photonic channels are the output occupation covariance of two indistinguishable photons through the interferometer U(t) = exp(-i 2 A t), averaged over every collision-free input pair, with threshold detection postselected on two clicks, at the same per-seed random times as zinc_cqrw1_reduced.json. Closed-form 2x2 permanents, checked against MerLin on the first 64 training graphs of every run. Otherwise identical to zinc_cqrw1_reduced.json. Reduced budget: 200 of 2000 epochs; results are partial.
